title: Learning Hidden Ecological and Epidemic Processes in a Reduced-Order Space
summary: We study data-driven learning of ecological and epidemic dynamics governed by nonlinear reaction and reaction--diffusion systems. We consider both neural approaches for learning the underlying reaction dynamics from trajectory data and Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) for discovering sparse, interpretable governing equations. A key component of this work is a partial-learning framework for reaction--diffusion systems.
